decisions.reason: The FAQ's prize-block description contains the superseded winner counts and sales thresholds for both Small and Big Block prizes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just had a thought.... I think we need to tweak the block prizes to
- Small = 1 x $500 every 100 sales.
- Big = 1 x $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

Same net $ amount given away but smoother, cleaner, clearer and more consistent stream of winners

value_updates.prize_block_description: Small Block awards 1 × $500 every 100 mint or secondary sales; Big Block awards 1 × $10,000 every 10,000 mint or secondary sales; pools are funded from every sale.

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing the Small Block winner count to 1 and its sales-count threshold to 100.
Changing prize winner counts and draw thresholds does not change the no-code trigger, ticket award, random recipient eligibility, or commission amount.
The source changes prize cadence and winner count while explicitly preserving the net giveaway amount; it does not change which sales fund the pools or the funding duration.
The source does not change random selection, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, on-chain execution, fairness, or verification.
The revised prize sizes and draw thresholds do not resolve or alter the separate manual-versus-automatic prize payout workflow.
The source changes when draws occur but does not alter the independent ticket counters, eligibility windows relative to each draw, post-draw reset actions, or ticket weighting.
Prize winner counts and draw thresholds do not affect referral badge conditions or milestone thresholds.
The source does not change the requirement for secondary-sale royalties, their flat structure, or the $10 amount.
The source preserves the net prize amount and does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, fiat-fee treatment, or whether primary mints fund prize pools.
The prize-mechanics change has no effect on the deferred Discord community server requirement.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat-to-USDC flow, supported payment methods, buyer profile, or wallet requirement.
